title: Model-bundle economics experiment matrix and go/no-go triggers
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: build a reproducible experiment matrix and go/no-go decision triggers to evaluate 'model bundles' (paired model variants and quantization levels) for Redwood customers. The deliverable will enable PM + Eng to recommend cost-latency-quality trade-offs per customer archetype and produce a short playbook for Dedicated/private deployment procurement decisions. Scope: competitive scan of 8 candidate model families, 3 quantization profiles, latency-first and cost-first bundle configs, and enterprise acceptance thresholds (accuracy/regression limits). We will coordinate with Applied ML for eval sets, Runtime for kernel/latency profiling, and Solutions for pilot customers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Experiment matrix with dimensions: model family, quantization, hardware class, prefix-cache enabled, batching strategy; 2) A synthetic + 3 customer-facing eval suites that surface quality regressions; 3) Measured P50/P95 token-latency and $/1K-token cost for each bundle on at least two hardware profiles; 4) Clear go/no-go rules (quantitative thresholds) and playbook artifacts in Confluence; 5) Presentation to GTM and Eng with proposed rollout plan.
deliverables: Benchmark dashboard link with P50/P95 and cost curves
Short tech-spec for Runtime to validate packaging
